title: REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 4 RECAP
content: Week 4 was a night of statement performances across the Revolution Men's League. Brody Lathrop dropped 49 points in a Blue blowout, White survived a fourth-quarter collapse and needed overtime to hold off Red, Purple edged past Pink for a second straight week, and Stefan Radan took over with a 47-point night to lead Orange past Black. Let's get into the action.

games.text: Blue made sure this game was over before it even got started. Brody Lathrop was locked in from the opening possession, knocking down shot after shot while Drew Pelkey and Henry Cogswell kept finding ways to score around him. Gray tried to hang on behind Tommy Brockmyre's scoring, but Blue's offense was relentless and the lead ballooned by the end of the first half. Blue led 48-23 at the half. There was little suspense left after the break, but Gray kept competing anyway. Tommy Brockmyre refused to quit, finishing with 32 points and eight rebounds, and John Helsel added a well-rounded stat line with 11 points, 10 rebounds and five assists. It wasn't nearly enough, though, as Blue kept its foot on the gas behind Lathrop's career-caliber night. Blue cruised to a 107-69 win.

performers.Blue: Brody Lathrop — 49 pts, 3 REB, 1 AST; Drew Pelkey — 25 pts, 11 REB, 3 AST; Henry Cogswell — 14 pts, 10 REB, 6 AST
performers.Gray: Tommy Brockmyre — 32 pts, 8 REB, 4 AST; John Helsel — 11 pts, 10 REB, 5 AST; Aiden Brown — 11 pts, 6 REB, 2 AST

games.text: White had to earn every inch of this one. Tyrone Conley and Aid Semic set the tone from the tip, attacking the paint and knocking down open looks as White built an early cushion. Edo Semic chipped in efficiently from the field, and White's balanced attack had Red on its heels for most of the opening half. White led 38-26 at the break. Red wasn't done, though, and came storming back the moment the second half tipped off. Chris Cayole caught fire from deep and finished with 22 points, while Will Oboh added 15 and Jaren Jeffcoat controlled the glass with 15 rebounds. Red outscored White in the fourth quarter to force overtime, but White's poise down the stretch was enough to close it out. White survived in overtime, 82-77.

performers.White: Tyrone Conley — 24 pts, 5 REB, 4 AST; Aid Semic — 19 pts, 10 REB, 1 AST; Kolby Bradford — 14 pts, 8 REB, 2 AST
performers.Red: Chris Cayole — 22 pts, 8 REB, 2 AST; Will Oboh — 15 pts, 5 REB, 3 AST; Jaren Jeffcoat — 14 pts, 15 REB, 2 AST

games.text: Purple was determined not to let Pink complete the sweep. Dylan Pratico and Kevin Garrison combined to keep Purple in front from the jump, splitting time attacking the rim and hitting from beyond the arc. Pink leaned on Donnie Dwyer to answer, but Purple's balance on both ends carried it to a slim lead at the half. Purple led 30-27 at the half. Pink kept pushing after the break, refusing to let Purple pull away. Donnie Dwyer erupted for 25 points on the night, and Matt Riordan added 17 to keep Pink within reach deep into the fourth quarter. But Purple matched Pink's second-half surge and got just enough down the stretch from Garrison and Pratico to seal it. Purple pulled away late for a 65-57 win.

performers.Purple: Kevin Garrison — 19 pts, 9 REB, 3 AST; Dylan Pratico — 17 pts, 5 REB, 3 AST; Brody Snow — 10 pts, 6 REB, 2 AST
performers.Pink: Donnie Dwyer — 25 pts, 10 REB; Matt Riordan — 17 pts, 8 REB, 3 AST; Jeromy Anderson — 5 pts, 6 REB, 2 AST

games.text: Orange put this one away in the opening minutes. Stefan Radan was nearly unstoppable right from the start, scoring from every level and pulling down rebounds on both ends. Will Ewald and the rest of Orange fed off his energy, and Black had no answer for the onslaught as the lead ballooned before the first half was even over. Orange led 51-31 at the break. Black clawed back some pride in the second half, even if the outcome was already decided. Seth Jackson caught fire late, finishing with 23 points, and Tavarius Vance added 17 of his own to help Black outscore Orange in the fourth quarter. It was too little, too late, though, as Radan's 47-point explosion had already put the game out of reach. Orange held on for a 78-66 win.

performers.Orange: Stefan Radan — 47 pts, 13 REB, 3 AST; Will Ewald — 13 pts, 7 REB, 2 AST; Josh Carter — 6 pts, 10 REB, 7 AST
performers.Black: Seth Jackson — 23 pts, 3 REB, 1 AST; Tavarius Vance — 17 pts, 7 REB, 2 AST; Kaleb Swetty — 8 pts, 3 REB, 3 AST
